summary: Novanta Inc. filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, disclosing a $300 million private placement of 2,142,857 common shares at $140.00 per share to institutional and accredited investors, expected to close June 11, 2026. The company also entered into a registration rights agreement to register the resale of shares. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event is involved. The filing covers customary agreements for a PIPE, with no premium, strategic review, or structural change indicative of special-situations categories.
